gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi reads contemporary and neutral, its lowercase filling the line almost like capitals. Nordic, by contrast, is powerful and ancient, with closed letters and a stroke that never swells or thins.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Nordic brings a powerful, ancient feel, its closed, tightly folded letters set against the gently open s curves of Noto Sans Kannada. The tension between shut and open forms is the draw.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Nordic is powerful and ancient, every letter drawn in one weight. Shrink the heading and its closed shapes tighten further, while Noto Sans Khudawadi leaves its rounds open like an unlatched hook.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Noto Sans Mandaic comes across professional, its lowercase rising close to capitals and its curves loose. But Nordic's strokes hold the steadiness of a drawn string, giving the display heading a powerful, ancient edge.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-meetei-ma: Nordic spaces its letters like brush dabs set far apart, each one a closed, cramped shape. Yet Noto Sans Meetei Mayek opens its rounds like a cracked bangle, so the pair's real quality is closed against open.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-newa: Powerful and ancient, Nordic arrives with closed, cramped letterforms. Noto Sans Newa opens the mouth of its lowercase e and keeps tall counters, a modern, open foil for that tightness.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Drawn with one pen tip, Nordic looks powerful and ancient. Nordic does best at commanding attention, while Noto Sans Oriya does best with generous curve gaps and near-capital lowercase.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-syriac-we: Single-width lines like a rolling-ball pen's trail: that is Nordic, powerful and ancient. Yet Noto Sans Syriac Western holds its terminals far from the stroke and packs its small letters tall like bundled cable.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-takri: Powerful and ancient, in one weight from stem to round. Nordic stays closed while Noto Sans Takri leaves every small round generously unclosed, so let the body go a bit larger and those openings show.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Joints that never thin or bulge: powerful, ancient Nordic. Nordic is best at stamping a headline with presence, while Noto Sans Tirhuta is best at a tall, open, cut-back lowercase.
